description: Environment setup: install dependencies and verify the existing test suite passes. Fix vitest config to exclude e2e/ directory from vitest collection (spec requirement).
steps: Run `cd frontend && npm ci` to install dependencies.
Run `cd frontend && npx vitest run` to verify existing tests pass.
Run `cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit` to verify type-checking passes.

Fix vitest config in frontend/vite.config.ts: add `exclude: ['e2e/**', 'node_modules/**']` to the test config to prevent Playwright test files from being mis-collected by vitest (the spec notes 8 Playwright suites are mis-collected).
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run passes all existing tests (no failures)
npx tsc --noEmit passes with no errors
E2E files under frontend/e2e/ are excluded from vitest collection
findings: All 1256 tests pass. 8 e2e suites were being mis-collected by vitest (missing SUPABASE_URL env var). Fixed by adding exclude: ['e2e/**', 'node_modules/**'] to vitest config. After fix: 88 test files, 1256 tests all green. Build succeeds. Two pre-existing TS6133 errors exist (unused vars in ValidationOverlayLayer.tsx:35 and publishStore.ts:310) - these are NOT caused by this change and exist on the base branch. NODE_OPTIONS env var must be cleared (NODE_OPTIONS='') when running npm/vitest/tsc in this sandbox due to missing proxy-bootstrap.js.
